Title: Product Marketing Lead (Core Banking)
Description:
• At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline
    • ,
  • We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets)
    • ,
  • We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers
    • ,
  • Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products
    • ,
  • If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you
    • ,
  • This is a player/coach role
    • ,
  • You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market
    • ,
  • If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here
    • ,
  • Set strategy for multiple categories. You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time
    • ,
  • Set the market intelligence agenda. You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond
    • ,
  • Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation
    • ,
  • Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale
    • ,
  • Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition
    • ,
  • Raise the bar for Product Marketing. You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team

Requirements

  • You think beyond a single product. You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications
    • ,
  • You own the hardest calls in your domain. You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious
    • ,
  • You bring senior people with you. You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious
    • ,
  • You're a player/coach. You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you

Title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineering)
Description:
• The Experience Library team is part of the Digital Marketing Technology organization at Salesforce. We build and own a content authoring and rendering platform that powers marketing pages across salesforce.com
    • ,
  • Our platform enables marketing teams to create high-quality, localized, and performant web experiences at scale, powering some of the highest-traffic pages in the Salesforce digital ecosystem
    • ,
  • We work across the full stack, with a strong frontend focus; building modular blade component libraries, WordPress integrations, and a robust rendering layer that serves global audiences
    • ,
  • We are looking for a Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) to join the Experience Library team as a senior frontend-focused full-stack engineer
    • ,
  • In this role, you will be a key technical contributor and domain expert on the Page Builder platform; designing and building high-quality, scalable frontend components, collaborating closely with Product and UX, and helping elevate the engineering practices of the team
    • ,
  • You will take strong ownership of your features, contribute to architectural decisions, and serve as a mentor and technical coach for more junior engineers. You will also help shape how we integrate AI tools into our daily development workflows
    • ,
  • Design, build, and maintain high-quality, production-grade frontend and full-stack features for the Page Builder platform, leveraging modern web technologies including JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML5, CSS3, and Node.js
    • ,
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for one or more domains within the Page Builder platform; including the blade components library, CMS integration, or rendering pipelines
    • ,
  • Build and ship modular, reusable, and accessible UI components that power salesforce.com marketing pages at scale
    • ,
  • Take ownership of features from design through execution; writing design specs, defining test strategies, and delivering code that meets quality, performance, and observability standards
    • ,
  • Actively integrate AI tools (e.g., Agentforce, Slackbot, Cursor, Claude, Codex) into your engineering workflow to accelerate development and help up-level the team's use of AI
    • ,
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Principal Engineers, Architects and cross-functional engineering teams to define requirements and deliver exceptional digital experiences
    • ,
  • Mentor AMTS and MTS team members through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing
    • ,
  • Contribute to code reviews, proactively monitor features in production, and champion engineering best practices and quality standards
    • ,
  • Help manage delivery complexity: slice stories and epics, define tasks, and expose dependencies and risks during sprint planning
    • ,
  • Present designs to internal groups and contribute to internal retrospectives, playbooks, and documentation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and full-stack web development
    • ,
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, with hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (React preferred; Vue, Angular, or Ember also considered)
    • ,
  • Solid experience with HTML5, CSS3, and CSS frameworks such as Sass or Tailwind
    • ,
  • Experience with Node.js and building backend services that support frontend experiences (BFF pattern a plus)
    • ,
  • Experience working with Content Management Systems, particularly WordPress and/or Contentful, and understanding of how CMS-driven content flows into frontend rendering pipelines
    • ,
  • Proven experience building scalable, performant web applications on public cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure also considered)
    • ,
  • Experience consuming RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs, with a solid understanding of API design and security best practices
    • ,
  • Strong understanding of web performance fundamentals such as Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, caching strategies, and CDN behavior
    • ,
  • Experience with frontend testing methodologies and frameworks (Jest, Cucumber, Selenium, or equivalent)
    • ,
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead and deliver features of medium-to-high complexity, from design through production
    • ,
  • Experience mentoring engineers, providing technical coaching and constructive code review feedback
    • ,
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to document features and present designs to peers and stakeholders
    • ,
  • A related technical degree required
    • ,
  • (Desirable) A demonstrated, AI-first approach to engineering actively using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex etc.) to move faster and help the team do the same
    • ,
  • (Desirable) Experience with internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n); building experiences that scale across multiple languages and regions
    • ,
  • (Desirable) Experience working within or contributing to a design system or component library
    • ,
  • (Desirable) Familiarity with WordPress as a CMS platform, including theme development or Page/REST API consumption
    • ,
  • (Desirable) Experience with build tools such as Webpack, Vite, npm, or Yarn
    • ,
  • (Desirable) Experience with CDN configuration (e.g., Akamai) and understanding of how CDNs impact web performance
    • ,
  • (Desirable) Experience with analytics instrumentation and tag management (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe, Tealium)
    • ,
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience as an active sprint contributor and planning partner
    • ,
  • Experience building with accessibility standards (WCAG) in mind
    • ,
  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Technology, or equivalent experience
